## Target branch

- [ ] `feature/*` → `frontend` or `backend` (squash and merge)
- [ ] `frontend` / `backend` → `main` (create a merge commit)
- [ ] `fix/*` → `main` (urgent production fix)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes in the app I changed
- [ ] Lint and type-check pass
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or `node_modules` committed
- [ ] `docs/` updated if behaviour or setup changed
